title: The most boring code is the most important code.
hook: The most important code in our system is deliberately the most boring.
thesis: The live Orca path is unglamorous on purpose: an event arrives on the Postgres-backed spine, crosses the event-to-mission bridge, lands in the MissionRuntime, the scheduler polls, and the WorkerRuntime dispatches to the registered worker by exact event-type match. Workers emit the next event and the chain continues to a terminal state. This post shows the boring path on screen and argues that reliability is the feature.

verified: The live path: Postgres-backed event spine, event-to-mission bridge (28 event types), MissionRuntime, scheduler, WorkerRuntime dispatch by exact event-type match (orca-omniroute-audit 2026-09-13 sections 2, 5, 6, via SYSTEMS.md section 4).
Every attempt carries identity, tenant binding, capability binding, and a receipt (audit, via SYSTEMS.md section 4).
inferred: Commodity queues and schedulers were deliberately harvested, not rebuilt (audit, via SYSTEMS.md section 4).

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
